items.title: Global Demand for Food | AQA GCSE Geography | Food 1
items.description: Tutor2u video on the uneven global distribution of food, rising demand and the difference between surplus and deficit countries.

items.title: Impacts of Food Insecurity | AQA GCSE Geography | Food 3
items.description: Tutor2u video covering the social, economic and environmental consequences of food insecurity including famine and undernutrition.

items.title: Global Food Supply & the Impact of Food Insecurity | AQA GCSE Geography
items.description: Concise overview of global food supply patterns and the wide-ranging impacts of food insecurity for GCSE revision.

items.title: Food Insecurity | GCSE Geography
items.description: Clear explainer on what food insecurity means, where it is most severe, and why some regions face chronic food deficits.

items.title: Rotten (2018)
items.description: Netflix investigative docuseries that travels into the global food supply chain to expose the forces driving food inequality and insecurity.

items.title: A Place at the Table (2012)
items.description: Documentary using personal stories to examine food insecurity and hunger, showing what happens when millions lack reliable access to food.

items.title: That Sugar Film (2014)
items.description: Australian documentary exploring how hidden sugars in everyday foods drive poor nutrition and health inequality in high-income countries.

items.title: How Does Food Insecurity Affect People? - Internet Geography
items.description: Detailed notes on the human impacts of food insecurity including famine, undernutrition, rising prices and social unrest.

items.title: Areas of Food Surplus & Food Deficit - Seneca Learning
items.description: AQA-matched revision notes and practice questions on global food surplus and deficit patterns.

items.title: Food Insecurity - Coolgeography
items.description: Illustrated GCSE revision page covering causes and consequences of food insecurity with maps and case study examples.

items.title: The Food Chain - BBC World Service
items.description: BBC World Service podcast examining the economics, politics and science of what the world eats, including episodes on global hunger and food security.
